Name: (CP) The Tractor Mods Midlife Glowup
Author: GrimReapers1121
Description:
[center]One of the mods I cannot live without is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] so I wanted to make a visual overhaul for the tractor.

Includes a﻿ Green, Red AND Blue version, just for you.

~~~~~~~~~~~
     Installation
~~~~~~~~~~~

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ (Another mod by the amazing Pathoschild)
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] (obvi)
3. Install this mod
4. (optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (By spacechase0)
5. Start the game and play!

~~~~~~~~~~~
   Compatibility
~~~~~~~~~~~﻿

This mod should be compatible with any other mod (I believe) as it only edits the tractors files


[/center]
